BiblicalUsage: Aram-zobah is named only in the title of Psalm 60, which says the psalm was written when David strove with Aram-naharaim and with Aram-zobah, and Joab returned and smote twelve thousand Edomites in the valley of salt. The name itself never appears in a numbered verse.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a name kept only in a psalm's title is still part of the story, because the title tells us what David was fighting when he wrote the song.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
